constraints: option selects a standard printing option (one of the PrintOptionSelector enum's Integer constants) or a PDF option code (a Text string of the form "OptionType:OptionName"); which of value1/value2 are meaningful, and their expected types, depends entirely on which option was passed (see the PrintOptionSelector enum's per-entry description, e.g. Paper option returns width in value1 and height in value2; Orientation option uses value1 only; Destination option returns a PrintDestinationTarget code in value1 and a pathname in value2; Print preview option returns a PrintPreviewMode code in value1). See the SET PRINT OPTION command description for the full per-option value contract.
If the current value for the given option is not in the predefined list, value1 returns -1 and OK is set to 1; if an error occurs, value1 and OK are both set to 0.
Mainly supports PostScript printers; some options may be unavailable on other printer types (PCL, Ink, etc.).
